verdict.rationale: Okta's first-party docs describe event hooks as outbound HTTPS REST calls sent to a URL you specify when specified events occur in your org. That is a registrable webhook mechanism that downstream systems can receive and react to. missing for 10: an explicit list of user lifecycle and authentication event types, delivery/retry and verification details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can subscribe to identity events — webhooks/event hooks fire on user lifecycle and auth events so downstream systems react in real time

citations.quote: Event hooks are outbound calls from Okta, sent when specified events occur in your org. They take the form of HTTPS REST calls to a URL you specify
